messages:
Ivy: Tiny lunchtime experiment: 'Mobility Roulette' 10 people spin a list of 5 micro-stretches and we do the picked one together at 12:30 for 5 mins. low effort, high vibes. who's up? :spinning_disk:
Marco: Sounds fun. What are the five options?
Ivy: 1) seated thoracic twist, 2) hip CARs, 3) calf wall release, 4) banded shoulder distractions (use towel), 5) 90/90 hamstring check. each move 60s.
Liz: i like that. can we include a "chair yoga" mute option for people on calls?
Ivy: yes scaled/mute-friendly options included. you can do seated versions.
Omar: @stretch-bot can you set a recurring roulette reminder and randomly pick moves?
stretch-bot: stretch-bot: I can post a roulette at 12:25 daily and pick a micro-stretch. Reply "in" to join today's round. I'll also log attendance.
Liz: in (today). bringing my travel yoga mat.
Marco: in (today). will film a 10s blooper reel if anyone wants it.
Ivy: tiny incentive: the person who shows up most this week wins first pick of leftover snacks on Friday. low stakes. :cookie:
Omar: love a snack bribe. also quick ask: anyone got a spare strap or band i can borrow?
Liz: got a band in locker 3, i'll bring it.
Ivy: OK 12:25 reminder set. see you near the plants for 5 mins of stretchy chaos. :)
